summary: Completed comprehensive testing of TrusteD-V Marketplace and Product Pages features. All 14 features verified successfully. Products page has HSM Integration removed, 4 categories with Learn More buttons. New dedicated pages for Secure Boot (rboot/rustBoot with GitHub links), Crypto Stack (algorithm tables), and RTOS Benchmark (RTOS options + benchmark table) all working. Marketplace has Hardware and IP Blocks tabs with partner logos. Landing page pricing aligns with 4 revenue streams.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Marketplace and Product Pages features verified. Products page at /product-suite has 4 categories (Development Tools, Secure Foundation, SDKs & Middleware, Debugging & Testing) with Learn More buttons linking to dedicated pages. HSM Integration card removed. New pages: /product/secure-boot (rboot + rustBoot with GitHub links), /product/crypto-stack (algorithm tables), /product/rtos-benchmark (RTOS options + benchmark table). Marketplace at /marketplace has Hardware tab (from API) and IP Blocks tab (static catalog) with partner logos strip. Partners page shows C-DAC, Mindgrove, Upbeat Tech with PartnerLogo component. Landing page pricing shows 3 tiers (Basic, Pro, Enterprise) with per-core/per-project/custom pricing aligned with 4 revenue streams. WebIDE has 'Cloud' badge.
